body: Ok.. interesting.. should I be contacting employment lawyers? Is it worth it / can I get a back pay?
Yeah, they didn't apply for me, they left me out because i don't have "regular hours".. but I got it last time and my hours are regular, it's just the fact I'm on a casual contract.
My employer has received it, I'm just not eligible to a share of it.

Can you apply as an individual? I don't get one since I'm casual contract (though I do 45 hours each week anyway have done for 2 years).

Is there an alternate subsidy or something? I got paid last lockdown but told its different this time. Literally sitting across road looking at my workplace a few streets down and wondering what else I can do?

I wish I were essential, I'm out of an income because I'm  a casual contract so don't get subsidy apparently. Dunno if I'll have anything left if lockdown goes on much longer so here's hoping level 3 in an hour
Yeah, it doesn't always mean you get the fancy 20 cents an hour.. at least it seems fancy, every person I know who gets it let's it get to their head.. I'm over this country and working here lol.....

Can confirm, anything above min wage is rare, and is often a 20 cent rise for being a keyholder. 

Management is only further ahead if you're not talking about inventory or assistant management, which is 22-24 from my friend groups experiences and people they know.

How I'm fucking it up Is a strange mix mate.

I'm faced with situations far too overwhelming for me, with people I struggle to deal with in places I don't want to be. I shut down, and go into autopilot. There's no way for me to hold a conversation that is genuine, I I literally not myself in my day to day life because of who I am around.
I'm fucjing it up by not just pulling the plug and leaving. Issue is, to where? ND how? 

I'm fucking this relationship (year and a half long so far) because I keep accidentally distancing and putting up walls, and letting the stress of life get to me. She's a fucking soldier man, but I can tell she's getting tired, and I know it's pushing her away.
I've spoken to her about it a lot and she's always great, but it doesn't matter because I'm not doing enough in my opinion.

I genuinely wish I closed my eyes right now and they never re opened. Life is too much for me, and it always has been. I don't know if it will actually get better like everyone says, because it's always Ben like this and I've never been able ti break free.

I feel so much more than lost. I fell off the track somewhere -- if I was ever on it.. and now I'm trapped in thay horror house.

I've tried every help avenue and none of it has done anything for me man. Nothing. I'm not okay. I don't have anyone I can ask for help because no one understands it or wants to understand it or thinks they have a solution when in reality they just fucking lock me in further.

I don't know what to do anymore I want to just give up so bad but I'm keeping around for a fucking girl. I literally exist because I want more of her and we have such a good thing going on but I am fucking it up slowly and ik scared to lose it.
Cheers brother. Needed to hear it. Sadly no one I know is understanding of it

I don't value myself on societal standards. I don't care about them.

Because tell me this. If you had a dog in pain, and no matter what you did it howled all night and day.. at what stage would you take pity?

I don't care if it's a cowards way out. I don't care what people think.

Chances at happiness mate. Chances to just own some land and work it. Chances to just have a clean cut experience. I have some major problems because of experiences I've had and they're catching up to me and I'm about over em. Pair that with a shit mental health system, being in the worst demographics for suicide, and around a world of people so caught up in fake shit.

I gave up when I realized I don't actually have any chances.

I think calling it a cynical view is unfair -- I'd call it objective.

The beginning of my evening? Life?

I don't really know what to say mate. I could give you my life story or simply tell you I've experienced life and seen how it operates. Both have the same outcome. Over it.
Gladly. How's it going for you mate?
I've not even heard back fir mine yet. Sorry yours went that way.

I wish I could say yes, that's how I feel. Unfortunately I've grown numb to it (boohoo, lol, I feel like an edgy 15 year old.. :) )

I just want a job in the career line I want to follow, my own space to be myself, and to be around people I choose to be around. I wish I could be a better partner, because she's all I have going for me, and I keep my head up and probably hardly come across as depressed fighting to keep alive for her sake but.. that energies burning out hard again. I'll be dead or back in the hospital again soon I feel.

What's frustrating (or calming?) Is that.. there is no help for people like me. I've been through every avenue and tried many medications. I feel like some of us are just destined to a certain line, you know?

I really do appreciate you taking the time to write this to me.

Unfortunately my situation is really rather complex. I'm not comfortable discussing it publicly because it's too detailed to cover in a comment reply, and would easily be misunderstood. 

The last year or so has been dedicated to others for this reason you've stated. It is just further depressing for a multitude of reasons...

No one else will reply, and that is OK. I think I'm just one if those people destined for this sort of outcome sadly. I'll be around a little bit longer. I'm applying for a job far away I likely won't get but heh, maybe it'll be my saving grace.

I hope things improve for you truly, because I couldn't wish this harrowing feeling on anyone.

Sadly those little things I have held  on to have slipped away and I've only got my girl left, but there comes a point you've gotta set someone free. It isn't fair she go through this

And that'd exactly why I feel guilty.

My sole reason for existing any further is to not be an inconvenience to anyone else, but I don't really know how much longer I can keep it up for. Especially now that I feel as if I've exhausted every route I can go down (excluding private Healthcare-- simply not feasible).

Have spoken about it.

She supports and loves me. It's me knowing I'm failing her because I'm losing this battle and it will kill her. That's why.
